name: Sen Triplets
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, choose target opponent. This turn, that player can't cast spells or activate abilities and plays with their hand revealed. You may play lands and cast spells from that player's hand this turn.
flavor: They are the masters of your mind.
rulings: [{'date': '2020-08-07', 'text': 'Abilities that create replacement effects, such as a permanent entering the battlefield tapped or with counters on it, are unaffected by Sen Triplets.
